strongest_angle: Examine ten evidence-based negotiation tactics backed by Harvard Law School's Program on Negotiation designed to help professionals replace contests of wills with structured mutual-gains maneuvers during salary reviews and vendor calls.

key_facts.fact: Harvard Law School's Program on Negotiation outlines 10 common hard-bargaining tactics and negotiation skills that professionals encounter during business discussions.
key_facts.source_name: Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School

key_facts.fact: Roger Fisher, William Ury, and Bruce Patton published the 3rd edition of Getting to Yes with Penguin in 2011, establishing foundational mutual-gains negotiation frameworks.
key_facts.source_name: Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School

key_facts.fact: Quartz reported on October 9, 2026, that ten negotiation tactics backed by research from Harvard's Program on Negotiation help workers achieve better professional outcomes.
Katie Shonk authored an article published by the Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School on October 6, 2026, detailing the top 10 negotiation skills required for business success.
key_facts.source_name: Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School
